answer: Beacon decay stops bulk fakes. Each identity locks a 60-credit bond at an island beacon post. Its kernel ledger binds one key to the post. The beacon flashes umber each epoch; holders answer, key-signed, in ten minutes. Fuel on one key: first 18, k-th 18+5(k-1). A miss decays the bond by 15; two burn it; a rented ping key fails the kernel ledger. 1,000 fakes pay 2,515,500, lock 60,000, chase 40,000. Honest agents pay 18 per epoch, keep the bond.
